messages:
Sasha: FYI the python sampleapp generator is emitting Any for nested object fields. breaks mypy/pyright in our quickstart

Sasha: simple repro:
```python
# generated
class Item(BaseModel):
    id: str
    attrs: Any  # should be TypedDict or nested model

# user code
async for ev in client.stream_items(...):
    a = ev.model_output.attrs
    name = a.get('name')  # no autocomplete, mypy warns
```

Riley: can repro, saw same in onboarding. quick workaround: typing.cast(Dict[str, Any], a) but that's gross

Priya: suggestion: codegen flag --prefer-typed-dict to emit TypedDict when schema has properties, and update async stubs to AsyncIterator[Item] rather than Any

codegen-bot: opened draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/815 updating pydantic_v1 target to prefer TypedDict for object schemas with properties

Riley: nice. can we add a mypy smoke check to sampleapp CI so this fails fast on PRs?

deploy-bot: CI: sampleapp/mypy-check  FAILED  1 error (mypy)

Priya: I'll add the CI job and a tiny regression test that imports generated types in a stream handler and runs mypy

Sasha: thanks — once PR lands I'll re-run onboarding flow and update quickstart docs if needed

Riley: landed locally with PR branch, typed fields show up and mypy is clean. will review PR tonight.
